document: ET-8b independent 300 (seed 73) — the BASE arm, scored against a prediction written before it was computed

prediction.written: 2026-09-21 05:05Z, docs/et8b-ind73-base-prediction.md, while the arm was mid-run

verdict: INSIDE the band. 20.7% against a 15-24% prediction, actions 8.19 against seed 21's 8.31. The harness is behaving and the gen0/gen1 arms can be built on it.
why_a_prediction_was_written_first: a base arm is the one number in this run with independent priors, so it is the one that can catch a harness fault before it becomes a finding. Written afterwards, any number looks like what was expected. The failure branch was fixed too: below 12% or above 30% would have meant investigating the slices, the budget and silent per-episode errors BEFORE reporting anything, because a base that disagrees with four independent priors is a harness fault until proven otherwise and both other arms inherit it.
